subject: The landscape theorem tower (5 theorems)
headline: Every theorem re-checked at issue time: the exact structure of the flux landscape is the D3 tadpole, it is unique, and it is complete. The failure mode here is a proof that does not compile, and all five compile.

findings.question: Does Mitchell's Uniqueness hold when the checker is re-run?
findings.answer: the D3 tadpole F^T J H is the unique bilinear symplectic invariant of the flux
findings.falsifier: scripts/validate_mitchell_uniqueness.py exits non-zero — a single failing symbol fails the theorem

findings.question: Does Constraint-First (Weyl FFT) hold when the checker is re-run?
findings.answer: the constraint-first construction reproduces the Weyl FFT degrees of freedom
findings.falsifier: scripts/validate_constraint_first.py exits non-zero — a single failing symbol fails the theorem

findings.question: Does Mitchell's Completeness hold when the checker is re-run?
findings.answer: the structure is complete: 6 exact and 2 numeric checks
findings.falsifier: scripts/validate_mitchell_completeness.py exits non-zero — a single failing symbol fails the theorem

findings.question: Does Full-duality completion hold when the checker is re-run?
findings.answer: the COMPLETE duality group, not just the monodromy subgroup
findings.falsifier: scripts/validate_full_duality.py exits non-zero — a single failing symbol fails the theorem

findings.question: Does Complete Exact Structure hold when the checker is re-run?
findings.answer: the assembly of the four theorems above
findings.falsifier: scripts/validate_all_theorems.py exits non-zero — a single failing symbol fails the theorem

limitations: These are theorems about the *structure of the landscape*, not predictions of observable physics: nothing here is measured against a laboratory.
The vacuum-energy prediction is not on this certificate; it is not verifiable and is recorded as such in the doctrine.
